units.locator: Beginning of document
units.text: This Federal Law establishes the basic principles of combating corruption and the legal and organizational foundations for preventing and fighting corruption and minimizing and/or eliminating the consequences of corruption offenses.
units.label: Beginning of document · “This Federal Law establishes the basic principles of combating…”

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: For the purposes of this Federal Law, the following basic concepts are used:
units.label: Art. 1 · “For the purposes of this Federal Law, the following basic…”

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: 1) corruption:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: а) abuse of official position, giving a bribe, receiving a bribe, abuse of authority, commercial bribery, or other unlawful use by an individual of their official position contrary to the lawful interests of society and the state for the purpose of obtaining benefits in the form of money, valuables, other property, property-related services or other property rights for themselves or third parties, or the unlawful provision of such benefits to that person by other individuals;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: б) commission of the acts specified in subpoint ‘а’ of this point on behalf of or in the interests of a legal entity;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: 2) combating corruption means the activities of federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, civil society institutions, organizations and individuals within their powers:
units.label: Point 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: а) to prevent corruption, including identifying and subsequently eliminating its causes (corruption prevention);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: б) to identify, prevent, suppress, detect and investigate corruption offenses (fighting corruption);
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: в) to minimize and/or eliminate the consequences of corruption offenses;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: 3) normative legal acts of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Point 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: а) federal normative legal acts (federal constitutional laws, federal laws, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, and normative legal acts of federal executive bodies and other federal bodies);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: б) laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: в) municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic Concepts Used in This Federal Law
units.text: 4) functions of state or municipal (administrative) management of an organization mean the powers of a state or municipal servant to take binding decisions on personnel, organizational, technical, financial, material-support or other matters concerning that organization, including decisions related to the issue of permits (licenses) for that organization to undertake a particular type of activity and/or individual actions, or to prepare drafts of such decisions.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Legal Basis for Combating Corruption
units.text: Article 2. Legal Basis for Combating Corruption
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legal Basis for Combating Corruption
units.text: The legal basis for combating corruption consists of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, generally recognized principles and norms of international law and international treaties of the Russian Federation, this Federal Law and other federal laws, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of other federal state authorities, normative legal acts of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Art. 2 · text

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: Combating corruption in the Russian Federation is based on the following basic principles:
units.label: Art. 3 · “Combating corruption in the Russian Federation is based on the…”

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 1) recognition, assurance and protection of fundamental human and civil rights and freedoms;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 2) legality;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 3) publicity and openness in the activities of state bodies and local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 4) the inevitability of liability for corruption offenses;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 5) the integrated use of political, organizational, information and publicity, socioeconomic, legal, special and other measures;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 6) priority use of corruption prevention measures;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic Principles of Combating Corruption
units.text: 7) cooperation between the state and civil society institutions, international organizations and individuals.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 1. The Russian Federation cooperates in combating corruption with foreign states, their law enforcement bodies and special services, and international organizations, in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation and/or on the basis of reciprocity, for the purposes of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 1) identifying persons suspected (accused) of corruption-related crimes and establishing their whereabouts, as well as the whereabouts of other persons involved in corruption-related crimes;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 2) identifying property obtained through corruption offenses or used as an instrument for their commission;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 3) providing, in appropriate cases, objects or samples of substances for examinations or forensic expert examinations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 4) exchanging information on combating corruption;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 5) coordinating activities to prevent and fight corruption.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. International Cooperation of the Russian Federation in Combating Corruption
units.text: 2. Foreign citizens, stateless persons who do not permanently reside in the Russian Federation, foreign legal entities having civil legal capacity and established under the laws of foreign states, international organizations and their branches and representative offices (foreign organizations) that are accused (suspected) of corruption offenses outside the Russian Federation are subject to liability under the legislation of the Russian Federation in the cases and according to the procedure provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation and federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 1) determines the principal directions of state policy on combating corruption;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 2) establishes the competence in combating corruption of the federal executive bodies whose activities the President directs;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 3) determines special rules for compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements and performance of duties established for combating corruption by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 2. The Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation ensures the drafting and adoption of federal laws on combating corruption and oversees the activities of executive bodies within its powers.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation allocates anti-corruption functions among the federal executive bodies whose activities it directs.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 4. Federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies combat corruption within their powers.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 4.1. Law enforcement bodies, other state bodies, local self-government bodies and their officials are obliged to inform the units for prevention of corruption and other offenses within the personnel services of the relevant federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies (or the officials of those personnel services responsible for preventing corruption and other offenses) of facts of which they become aware concerning a state or municipal servant’s failure to observe restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to fulfill duties established for combating corruption.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 5. To coordinate the activities of federal executive bodies, executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies in implementing state anti-corruption policy, bodies composed of representatives of federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and other persons may be formed by decision of the President of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as anti-corruption coordination bodies). To implement the decisions of anti-corruption coordination bodies, draft Presidential decrees, executive orders and instructions and draft Government resolutions, executive orders and instructions may be prepared and submitted according to the established procedure for consideration by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, respectively; acts (joint acts) may also be issued by federal state authorities and state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation whose representatives are members of the relevant anti-corruption coordination body. Upon receiving information on corruption offenses, anti-corruption coordination bodies forward it to the relevant state bodies authorized to verify such information and take decisions on the verification results according to the procedure established by law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 6. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and subordinate prosecutors, within their powers, coordinate the activities of the internal affairs bodies of the Russian Federation, federal security service bodies, customs authorities of the Russian Federation and other law enforcement bodies in fighting corruption, and exercise other anti-corruption powers established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 6.1. In cases provided for by federal laws, the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation cooperates with competent authorities of foreign states when authorized officials of state bodies, local self-government bodies and organizations verify compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements established for combating corruption by persons subject to those restrictions, prohibitions and requirements.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organizational Foundations of Combating Corruption
units.text: 7. The Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation ensures anti-corruption activity within its powers in accordance with Federal Law No. 41-ФЗ of 5 April 2013 ‘On the Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: Corruption is prevented through the following main measures:
units.label: Art. 6 · “Corruption is prevented through the following main measures:”

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 1) fostering intolerance of corrupt conduct in society;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 2) anti-corruption expert examination of legal acts and their drafts;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 2.1) consideration, at least once each quarter, by federal state authorities, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies and other bodies and organizations vested by a federal law with certain state or other public powers, of issues of law-enforcement practice arising from legally effective decisions of courts and commercial courts declaring non-normative legal acts invalid or decisions and actions (inaction) of those bodies, organizations and their officials unlawful, in order to develop and adopt measures to prevent and eliminate the causes of the violations identified;
units.label: Point 2.1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 3) imposing, according to the procedure established by law, qualification requirements on citizens applying to hold state or municipal offices or state or municipal service positions, and verifying the information submitted by those citizens according to the established procedure;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Corruption Prevention Measures
units.text: 4) establishing, as grounds for removal from the position held and/or dismissal from a state or municipal service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, or for imposing other measures of legal liability, failure to submit information or submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information on the person’s income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations, as well as submission of knowingly false information on the income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations of the person’s spouse and minor children;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 6
